summary: An 11-year-old boy from Golden fell from a guided raft on the Arkansas River in Browns Canyon (~10 miles north of Salida) on Wednesday afternoon when the three-person raft tipped on its side; the other two were rescued. Water-rescue teams searched with underwater cameras and scent dogs; a boy's body was found in the search area on Friday afternoon.
location: Browns Canyon, Arkansas River, ~10 miles north of Salida
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; water rescue teams
notes: Investigators had not confirmed the recovered body was the missing boy at the time of the 2015-06-12 CPR report; river running high from snowmelt and rain; incident Wednesday 2015-06-10 (Wednesday-verified), body found Friday 2015-06-12; Sheriff John Spezze. SARDOC June 11 2015 mission report: one SARDOC dog team worked ~5 miles of riverbank on ATV and on foot; the search dog showed strong interest at the rapids below the PLS and near the PLS shoreline, and the handler reported the subject was on the far side of the river; the subject was found by searchers near the PLS the following day on the far side. River running ~3,000 cfs. Run 580: Mountain Mail 'Body recovered from Arkansas River identified' appended (parent-opened this run); confirms Drake Durkee thrown from raft at Big Drop rapid June 10, PFD came off, body recovered June 12 just downstream of the site, likely foot entrapment.
